Generated from the live click command tree. Every leaf command has a synopsis, param table, and exit-code list. For exit-code semantics see `cli-command-surface` §2.2.

## keepsail

Keepsail — product-work control layer across agent harnesses.

```
keepsail [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS...]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--version`, `-V` | flag | `False` | Show the version and exit. |
| `--workspace` | directory | — | Project root (defaults to walk-up from cwd). |
| `--json` | flag | `False` | Machine-parseable JSON output. |
| `--quiet`, `-q` | flag | `False` |  |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | integer range | `0` |  |

## keepsail adapter

Install / uninstall / list keepsail integrations for frameworks + agents.

```
keepsail adapter COMMAND [ARGS...]
```

## keepsail adapter install

Install the <name> adapter (registers hooks + persists adapters.yaml).

```
keepsail adapter install [OPTIONS] NAME
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `NAME` | text | *required* |  |
| `--knowledge-context` | flag | `False` | Opt in/out of Claude/Codex session-bound context (otherwise preserve). |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` installed
- `1` generic error
- `2` unknown adapter name
- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail adapter list

List INSTALLED adapters (adapters.yaml entries), enriched from built-ins.

```
keepsail adapter list [OPTIONS]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--type` | {framework\|agent} | — | Only list adapters of this kind. |
| `--enabled-only` | flag | `False` | Only list adapters with enabled: true. |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success
- `1` generic error
- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail adapter scan-once

Run ONE synchronous observe() pass over <name>'s watch dir, emitting events.

```
keepsail adapter scan-once [OPTIONS] NAME
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `NAME` | text | *required* |  |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success (zero or more events emitted)
- `1` generic error (e.g. AgentAdapter passed)
- `2` precondition violation on emitted event
- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail attest

Lifecycle attestation: snapshot evidence + verify it covers a diff.

```
keepsail attest COMMAND [ARGS...]
```

## keepsail attest verify

Fail if any changed file lacks a complete, ordered, scope-covering attestation.

```
keepsail attest verify [OPTIONS]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--base` | text | *required* | Base ref/SHA (e.g. PR base.sha). |
| `--head` | text | *required* | Head ref/SHA (e.g. PR head.sha). |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` pass (every changed file covered)
- `2` blocker(s): uncovered file / scope drift / incomplete lifecycle
- `3` no `.harness/`
- `4` `git` failure (fail-closed; e.g. unreachable merge-base)

## keepsail attest write

Snapshot the per-change event slice to .harness/attestations/<slug>.jsonl.

```
keepsail attest write [OPTIONS] SLUG
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `SLUG` | text | *required* |  |
| `--format` | {v2\|v1-bootstrap} | — | Output version; v1-bootstrap is limited to reader-first upgrades. |
| `--disclose-gate-bypass` | text | — | Disclose+justify that the gate was bypassed during this change (clears the merge-gate blocker). |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success
- `1` no events for the slug (run the lifecycle first)
- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail decision

Author, ratify, and check decision records.

```
keepsail decision COMMAND [ARGS...]
```

## keepsail decision betray

Record that the anchored code no longer satisfies D. Does NOT advance the baseline (D stays suspect); resolution is human-only (re-ratify or fix the code).

```
keepsail decision betray [OPTIONS] DECISION_ID
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `DECISION_ID` | text | *required* |  |
| `--justification` | text | *required* | Why the changed code no longer satisfies the criterion. |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success
- `2` not a ratified tier-2 decision (or missing --justification)
- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail decision check

Whole-repo dangling check + executable checks: up=block(2) / down=warn / record error=3.

```
keepsail decision check [OPTIONS]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--changed` | flag | `False` | Only run checks whose anchored files moved. |
| `--gate-reconcile` | flag | `False` | Merge-boundary teeth: exit 2 on any suspect/unreconciled tier-2 decision (default mode only warns). |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` clean, or only warnings (dangling-down / tier-2 review-needed)
- `2` dangling-up / integrity / tier-1 check failure; or (with --gate-reconcile) a suspect/unreconciled tier-2 decision
- `3` record/config error or no `.harness/`

## keepsail decision reconcile

Record a tier-2 re-review verdict (code still satisfies D); re-stamp the baseline.

```
keepsail decision reconcile [OPTIONS] DECISION_ID
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `DECISION_ID` | text | *required* |  |

- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail done

Verify a change and emit implementation_complete on a pass.

```
keepsail done [OPTIONS] [SLUG]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `[SLUG]` | text | — |  |
| `--skip-verify` | flag | `False` | Skip verification; emit a synthetic verification_passed then complete. |
| `--pr` | text | — | PR number — when no positional <slug> is given, resolves the slug from the PR body's keepsail metadata block. The raw --pr value is ALSO recorded on implementation_complete as pr_url. |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success (verification passed → `implementation_complete` emitted)
- `1` sensor crashed or timed out
- `2` verification failed or pre-flight state gate failed
- `3` no `.harness/` or missing verification config
- `4` `--pr` resolution failure

## keepsail init

Initialize a project for keepsail.

```
keepsail init [OPTIONS]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--setup-github` | flag | `False` | Run gh CLI checks, write .github/pull_request_template.md and .github/workflows/keepsail.yml, and best-effort enable repo auto-merge/squash settings (requires gh). |
| `--framework` | {openspec\|spec-kit\|superpowers\|plain} | — | Explicit framework; default = auto-detect (v0.1: no-op placeholder; framework adapters auto-detect at install time.) |
| `--force` | flag | `False` |  |
| `--no-agent` | flag | `False` | Skip auto-installing the detected agent's gate hook. |
| `--integration` | {codex\|claude-code} | — | Coding-agent integration to configure; repeat for multiple selections. |
| `--review-producer` | text (repeatable) | — | Retired; reviewer producers are configured outside keepsail. |
| `--review-model` | text (repeatable) | — | Retired; keepsail does not select reviewer models. |
| `--yes` | flag | `False` | Skip the final confirmation in interactive mode. |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success
- `1` generic error
- `3` already initialized (no `--force`)
- `4` `gh` CLI missing (with `--setup-github`)
- `5` concurrent init lock contention

## keepsail knowledge check

Check unresolved obligations; this never grants execution permission.

```
keepsail knowledge check [OPTIONS] CHANGE
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `CHANGE` | text | *required* |  |
| `--paths` | text (repeatable) | — | Declared independent action paths (segment prefixes). |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success (a retained reject conclusion does not grant authority)

- `2` malformed/unrecognized evidence, corrupt knowledge, or unmet obligation
- `3` missing or invalid activated configuration

- `5` concurrent revision or operation identity conflict

## keepsail plan redeclare

Emit `plan_redeclared` (any active state → INTENT_DECLARED).

```
keepsail plan redeclare [OPTIONS] SLUG
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `SLUG` | text | *required* |  |
| `--reason` | text | `''` | Optional reason for reopening the change (recorded in redeclaration_history). |
| `--plan` | text | — | Submit a revision candidate as a new-contract plan subject. |
| `--commitment` | text (repeatable) | — | Binding revision commitment as ID=TEXT (repeatable). |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success
- `1` generic error
- `2` illegal lifecycle transition (terminal state / not-yet-started slug)
- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail report

Show what the harness measurably did for you over a repo/time-window.

```
keepsail report [OPTIONS]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--since` | text | — | Only count events and gate-block records on/after this ISO date (e.g. 2026-07-01). Unparseable = no lower bound (never errors). |
| `--until` | text | — | Only count events and gate-block records on/before this ISO date (a bare date counts through the end of that day). Unparseable = no upper bound. |
| `--brief` | flag | `False` | One-line summary only. |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success
- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail sync

Re-render the managed keepsail artifacts without re-running init.

```
keepsail sync [OPTIONS]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--agents-md` | flag | `False` | Re-render ONLY the AGENTS.md keepsail section (no .gitignore change). v0.1: built-in adapters contribute no verification.yaml checks yet, so the adapter-checks sync leg is a no-op (v0.2 adds it). |
| `--adapter` | text | — | Re-inject ONLY this adapter's subsection (no outer version bump). Wins over --agents-md / --gitignore if combined. |
| `--gitignore` | flag | `False` | Re-render ONLY the managed .gitignore block (no AGENTS.md change). Picks up `_CANONICAL_PATHS` additions from a keepsail upgrade without re-running init. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag | `False` | Skip the overwrite-confirm prompt. |
| `--check` | flag | `False` | Dry-run: report drift between the managed artifacts and the keepsail template WITHOUT writing. Exit 2 on drift. Composes with --agents-md / --gitignore; not supported with --adapter. |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` success
- `1` generic error
- `3` no `.harness/`


- `3` no `.harness/`

## keepsail verify

Run verification checks for a change and report the verdict.

```
keepsail verify [OPTIONS] [SLUG]
```

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `[SLUG]` | text | — |  |
| `--pr` | text | — | PR number — when no positional <slug> is given, resolves the slug from the PR body's keepsail metadata block. |
| `--layer` | {baseline\|adapter\|user} | — | Restrict the run to a single verification layer. |
| `--check` | text (repeatable) | — | Run only checks with this id (repeatable). |

**Exit codes:**

- `0` verdict pass
- `1` sensor crashed or timed out
- `2` verdict fail / config validation error / `--pr` malformed metadata
- `3` `.harness/verification.yaml` missing
- `4` `--pr` resolution failure (gh fetch / no block / missing Change field)
